name: Jordan Rivera

email.subject: Live in 60 days, signature to renewal
email.body:
Hi Priya,

Your VP Operations posting says Harborline promises every customer live in 60 days. That promise usually breaks at the handoffs between implementation, support, and training.

Quick on me: Director of Operations at Tidewater Freight Systems, 14 years in logistics software.

I cut average implementation time from 16 weeks to 9 weeks, and helped raise gross revenue retention from 89% to 95% in three years.

Would you have 15 minutes in the next two weeks?

Resume attached.

Jordan Rivera
(704) 555-0142
linkedin.com/in/jordan-rivera-example
